title: More Years of Life and More Life in Your Years
coreMove: Vitality grows when you stop feeding decline pictures and give the success mechanism fresh aims: lower stress, want more life, and act from useful purpose.

exampleSpecs.audience: patients treating age as a verdict
exampleSpecs.stakes: a decline picture could keep a patient from doing the work
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Use Hans Selye, 1956, The Stress of Life, and stress to connect mental climate with bodily wear

exampleSpecs.stakes: a lively phrase could become a false medical promise
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Treat the fountain of youth as functional vitality and renewal through the success mechanism

exampleSpecs.stakes: empty time could harden into a useless self-image
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Show enthusiasm, more life, purpose, and later years as a forward target

exampleSpecs.stakes: burnout language could become a decline picture for the whole staff
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Use Hans Selye, stress, 1956, and The Stress of Life to keep health claims grounded

exampleSpecs.stakes: marketing could hide the actual conditions draining vitality
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Use fountain of youth, vitality, renewal, and success mechanism without overclaiming

exampleSpecs.audience: caregivers facing withdrawal in later years
exampleSpecs.stakes: a loved one could accept isolation as the only honest future
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Show enthusiasm, more life, purpose, and later years as a small next act
